shortDescription: Manage Snapshots on PowerMax/VMAX Storage System

options.name: force
options.description: Whether to force delete the snapshot. Force deletion is required when the snapshot has a different number of source volumes than the current storage group configuration. This can occur when LUNs are added to a storage group after a snapshot is taken. The I(force) option is only supported with I(snapshot_id), not with I(generation).

options.name: generation
options.description: The generation number of the snapshot. Generation is required for link, unlink, rename and delete operations. Optional for Get snapshot details. Create snapshot will always create a new snapshot with a generation number 0. Rename is supported only for generation number 0.

options.name: link_status
options.description: Describes the link status of the snapshot.

options.name: new_snapshot_name
options.description: The new name of the snapshot.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the Unisphere host.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of the Unisphere host.

options.name: restore
options.description: Whether to restore a storage group to its snapshot.

options.name: serial_no
options.description: The serial number of the PowerMax/VMAX array. It is a required parameter for all array-specific operations except for getting a list of arrays in the Gatherfacts module.

options.name: sg_name
options.description: The name of the storage group.

options.name: snapshot_id
options.description: Unique ID of the snapshot. I(snapshot_id) is required for link, unlink, rename and delete operations. Optional for Get snapshot details.

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the snapshot should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The Time To Live (TTL) value for the snapshot. If the TTL is not specified, the storage group snap details are returned. However, to create a SG snap - TTL must be given. If the SG snap should not have any TTL - specify TTL as C(None).

options.name: ttl_unit
options.description: The unit for the I(ttl). If no I(ttl_unit) is specified, C(days) is taken as default I(ttl_unit).

options.name: unispherehost
options.description: IP or FQDN of the Unisphere host

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the Unisphere host.

options.name: verifycert
options.description: Specifies system whether to validate SSL certificate or not, Values can be True or False or a custom file path for SSL certificate with .pem extension or .cer with base 64 encoding.
